sourceOfTruth: student affairs production routes and Vue pages
student affairs dashboard, leave, risk, dorm, aid, funding, discipline, mental, stats and archive services
productionImplementationStatus: eleven high-frequency and high-risk workspaces registered; the full student-affairs menu is not yet claimed as prototype-complete
principles: unconfigured non-management scope fails closed and never falls back to tenant-wide data
the UI shows a user-facing scope label rather than internal scope codes
student master remains the single identity fact source and student 360 only aggregates authorized business facts
protected detail requires independent permission, purpose and audit
objective facts remain separate from discipline, risk or clinical conclusions
downloads inherit backend scope, masking, purpose, watermark and audit
prototype placeholders never represent production data
